messages:
hana: Quick creative request for the launch mini-lab: need three benchmark tiles (cost / latency / throughput), one 16:9 slide master, and a 600x360 webinar thumbnail. Keep everything brand-compliant and include light + dark themes. Deadline Wed AM.
leo: Got it. Any specific visual language for the benchmarks? full axes or simplified sparklines?
hana: Simplified sparklines with one bold callout number (p50) and a small p95 microcopy. For cost use 'per 1k tokens'. Add a tiny footnote: 'results representative, test conditions in notes'.
paul: Legal note: no superlatives. Use 'low-latency' / 'cost-efficient'. Also require a short legal microcopy for the slide: 'Internal devbench; representative results.'
brand-ops: Brand checklist: Redwood Sans, logomark >=72px, palette tokens only, primary copy contrast >=4.5:1. Provide alt-text for every export and a CSV manifest.
leo: I'll build a single Figma file with componentized tiles and language layers. Export presets: PNG 1920x1080, 1200x628, 800x800, 600x360; SVG icons. Include reduced-motion SVGs.
hana: Also need copy variants for social (two headline options) and short alt-text snippets for CMS ingestion.
figma-bot: Created file 'Mini-Lab / Launch Tiles' branch 'mini-lab-4455012345'  https://www.figma.com/file/mini-lab/mini-lab-4455012345
leo: ETA Tues EOD for first pass frames. I'll annotate frames with export names, alt text, and a 'representative' badge on sample numbers. Example export name: `mini_lab_tiles_v1_en_1200x628.png`.
legal-bot: Reminder: include a microcopy field in the asset manifest with exact legal phrasing. I'll review once branch is ready.
hana: Great  please flag if you hit layout issues with longer translations. If needed we can shorten subheads. Thanks team :sparkles:
